name: omp-plan-kit
description: Global Oh My Pi (OMP) plan kit with actionable plan contracts, deterministic plan validation, and bounded repair convergence.
author: stgmt

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.ts && node --check src/plan-core-requirement.ts && node --check src/plan-mode-hook.ts && node --check src/plan-validator.ts && node --check dist/extension.js && node --check scripts/install-all-profiles.mjs && node --check scripts/uninstall-all-profiles.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-plan-mode-hook.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-plan-mode-hook-mutations.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-plan-validator.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-validator-mutations.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-convergence-controller.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-programmer.mjs && node --check tests/e2e-real-plan-handoff.mjs
scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outfile dist/extension.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.e2e:all: bun tests/e2e-plan-mode-hook.mjs && bun tests/e2e-plan-mode-hook-mutations.mjs && bun tests/e2e-validator-mutations.mjs && bun tests/e2e-plan-validator.mjs && bun tests/e2e-convergence-controller.mjs && bun tests/e2e-programmer.mjs && bun tests/e2e-real-plan-handoff.mjs
